guard: after the endpoint says this session's stored copies reached their limit (#5404), the next cotal_inbox reply carries one notice in either attention mode, a peek keeps it, the read whose reply carries it clears it, and a read that throws, a caller that goes and a limit seen mid-read keep it for the next read
why: S1 drops the agent's listener, so the event marks nothing.
S2 never clears the notice, so every read repeats it.
S3 clears it on a peek, so the read after the peek loses it.

S4 and S5 drop it from the reply outside and inside focus mode, S8 from a focus reply with recall to report, and S9 from a read outside focus mode that shows a message, which builds its reply from what it takes.
S6 clears the notice when the read starts, as before the fix, so a recall that throws loses it.
S7 clears every limit the session saw, so one seen while a reply was built is never said.
S9 names 1000 whatever count the copy was stored under.
NO BUILD STEP: the suite imports ../src.

mutations.name: S1 the agent ignores the endpoint's event
mutations.find: this.ep.on("stored-copies-full", (full: { limit: number }) => { this._storedCopiesFull++; this._storedCopiesLimit = full.limit; });
mutations.expectRed: the endpoint's stored-copies-full event marks the session
mutations.cell: the endpoint's stored-copies-full event marks the session

mutations.name: S2 the notice is never cleared
mutations.expectRed: the read after it does not repeat it
mutations.cell: the read after it does not repeat it

mutations.name: S3 a peek clears the notice
mutations.expectRed: a peek carries the notice once and keeps it
mutations.cell: a peek carries the notice once and keeps it

mutations.name: S4 the reply outside focus mode drops the notice
mutations.expectRed: a peek carries the notice once and keeps it
mutations.cell: a peek carries the notice once and keeps it

mutations.name: S5 the empty focus reply drops the notice
mutations.expectRed: in focus mode the next read carries the notice once
mutations.cell: in focus mode the next read carries the notice once

mutations.name: S6 the notice clears before the reply exists
mutations.replace: const storedNote = storedSeen ? storedCopiesNote(agent.storedCopiesLimit) : ""; if (storedSeen && !keeps()) agent.clearStoredCopiesFull(storedSeen);
mutations.expectRed: in focus mode a read whose recall throws keeps the notice for the next read
mutations.cell: in focus mode a read whose recall throws keeps the notice for the next read

mutations.name: S7 clearing forgets a limit seen while the reply was built
mutations.expectRed: a limit seen while a reply is built is said by the next read, and then not again
mutations.cell: a limit seen while a reply is built is said by the next read, and then not again

mutations.name: S8 a focus reply with recall to report drops the notice
mutations.expectRed: in focus mode a read with recall to report carries the notice once
mutations.cell: in focus mode a read with recall to report carries the notice once

mutations.name: S9 the notice names the compiled 1000, not the count the endpoint reported
mutations.expectRed: the notice names the count the endpoint reported
mutations.cell: the notice names the count the endpoint reported

mutations.name: S10 a read that shows a message drops the notice
mutations.expectRed: a read that shows a message carries the notice once
mutations.cell: a read that shows a message carries the notice once
